name: fixed-branch-residue-digit-four-terms-v1

fixed_family.old_prefix: Every existing 299551 pair-laurent3-three-terms-integer14-v1 candidate, in its original order
fixed_family.four_terms: All four distinct lexicographically ordered monomials with each exponent in [0,3]; first coefficient 1, other coefficients independently in [-2,-1,1,2]
fixed_family.branch_leaves: All 49 old Laurent monomials plus all 40 two-term sums over [a^-1,b^-1,1,b,a] with first coefficient 1 and second in [-2,-1,1,2]; each leaf has both signs -1 and 1, for 178 leaves
fixed_family.branch_predicates: Each of [a,b,a+b,ab,abs(a-b)] reduced modulo q in [2,3], then compared with each threshold from 1 through q-1; 15 predicates
fixed_family.branches: Every predicate and every ordered pair of signed leaves, including equal leaves
fixed_family.recombinations: For each of the old 4767 two-term/integer programs f, each control g in [a,b,a+b,ab,abs(a-b)] and each q in [2,3,4], use (q*floor(f/q)+(g mod q)) mod p
fixed_family.digits: Low and high base-p digits of each ordinary integer expression [a,b,a+b,ab,abs(a-b)]; no modular reduction before digit extraction
fixed_family.states: Every result modulo the prime vocabulary, with the state space padded to a multiple of 4

selection: Keep every observationally consistent candidate. Preserve every eliminated block's independently checked two-record conflict. Independently check every retained state on every original row. Equal functions are not deduplicated.
model_input: Vocabulary and ordered rows [a,b,label] only; no task identity, target syntax, generator seed, oracle or heldout label.
lean: CM64 exact zero-block elimination, CM65/66 full reduced domain and projection geometry, CM67 inclusion for arbitrary added fixed input maps, CM68 packed observations. The 13 CM67 axiom checks were rerun before implementation. These do not supply unseen target identification.
flat_spectrum_role: Capacity bound on the complete complex head, separate from the finite input-family structural prior.
audit: Reuse the complete streamed partition and materialization engine at e5ef378a with the new crate-local family. Preserve every unknown row and every original record; no uniform-row replacement.
disk_reserve: Both original and repeat: 96*(128MiB report+8MiB input)+1GiB metadata, plus 2GiB workspace and 16GiB storage slack; sum requirements on a shared filesystem.
scope: Training-only compatibility and complete buffer forecasts on all 48 available original pools, preserving all 54 inventory entries. Zero heldout scoring or accuracy credit. Full model evaluation needs a separate prospective freeze and training seal.
